storyCards.fact:
Kt Tunstall's "Black Horse The Cherry Tree" reached #20 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #20 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 30 weeks on the chart.

Black Horse The Cherry Tree was released in 2006.
